main_topics: Overcoming personal loss and its impact on business

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Feeling stuck and unmotivated after personal loss

problems_addressed.specific_problem: Negative self-talk and comparison to others

episode_summary: In this episode, Michael Opyd coaches Emma Noon, a young real estate agent dealing with the aftermath of personal loss. They explore the importance of maintaining consistent routines and reconnecting with personal motivations to overcome feelings of being stuck. Michael emphasizes the power of mindset shifts and leveraging support systems to regain focus and drive in the real estate business.
